title: 3 easy steps to Learn the Chicken Dance

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses a step-by-step breakdown method with verbal enumeration and visual demonstrations. She explains movement variations and context in a structured tutorial format.

lesson_structure.note: Demonstration of the dance with partners
Introduction to the chicken dance tutorial
Third way of doing polka steps turning right and left
Historical background of the chicken dance

steps_taught.name: Little chicken moves
steps_taught.description: Snap beaks, flap wings, shake tail feathers, and clap four times.

steps_taught.name: Polka steps
steps_taught.description: Polka steps done in three different ways: with a partner, dosado, and turning in place.

what_works: Visual demonstrations with partners and solo
what_hinders: Rapid transition between partner and solo views

quotes.text: Today we're doing the chicken dance, a line dance how to.
Step one, our little chicken moves.
The third way we did it was to do polka steps in place.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates arm movements while facing the camera directly
Teacher counts aloud while demonstrating foot placement in place and turning

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down a single dance step into three distinct spatial variations: partner dance, dosado, and solo turns.
